_doc: Missions. map = citymap.js options (seed + district). waves: at (s after drop), kind, count, from ('edge' = the district's road ends, 'nest', or {x,z}), spread, every (repeat), until, elite (chance). objectives: kill / killAll / destroy (lots by index into the generated map's biggest lots of a recipe: pickLots) / survive / reach. optional objectives raise the grade. par.time = the time an A-grade run takes. pay = base pay. tier = loot tier (1 early … 5 late). length = 'short' 4-8 min | 'mid' 8-15 | 'long' 15+. comms = lines said in-world (who + text + when). night = time of day, 0 noon … 1 deep night.

missions.name: Drop Zone
missions.brief: The swarm has broken into the Glasswell business district. Drop in, clear the streets, get out.

comms.text: Frame, you're over Glasswell. Doors open in three. Swarm's thick on the east avenues.
Fuel depots on your map will go up if you hit them. Use that.
Big contacts moving in. Armoured fronts — get round behind them.
Dropship's on the pad, north-east corner. Come home.

missions.name: Fuel Line
missions.brief: A rival company is pumping our refineries dry. Burn their three tank farms before the convoy leaves.

comms.text: Three refineries, marked on your map. They're full. Stand well back when they blow.
They've brought rocket artillery. Watch the ground for the red circles.
Smoke's visible from orbit. Nice work. Pick-up's at the north-east lot.

missions.name: Hold the Line
missions.brief: Evacuation trains are leaving the Kettle Row station. Keep the swarm off it until the last one is out.

objectives.label: Hold until the last train leaves

comms.text: Four minutes, Frame. The trains don't stop for anything.
Swollen ones coming in. Don't let them reach you — pop them at range.
Ground's moving under the station. Something's digging.
Last train's boarding. This is everything they've got.

missions.name: Cold Cargo
missions.brief: Halden-Voss is trucking the Saltmarsh cold stores out of the city — food the shelters need. Stop the haulers before they reach the coast road.

comms.text: Six haulers, one road out. They won't stop to fight you — they just want the coast road.
First truck's rolling. The escort will try to keep you busy. Don't let it.
Tank on the dock road. Its front plate's thick; get round it.
Cold stores are staying put. Nice. I'm on the north pad.

missions.name: Dead Air
missions.brief: Spindle Quarter is contested: swarm in the streets, Halden-Voss relay masts on the roofs jamming every channel we have. Plant charges on the masts and give the city its voice back.

objectives.label: Plant charges on the relay masts (4)

comms.text: Four masts, marked. Stand on each one until the charge is set. Moving off it loses you time.
Jammer walker inbound. Your locks will drop near it — kill it with your guns.
Red line on your screen means a sniper has you. Break line of sight.
I can hear you clearly for the first time all week. Pad's north-east.

missions.name: Last Bus Out
missions.brief: Four haulers full of Ashgrove families are crossing the district to the evacuation line. The swarm can smell them. Get at least three through.

comms.text: Haulers are lined up at the south gate. They'll go when you're down.
Convoy's moving. When the swarm piles on a truck it slows to a crawl — clear the road ahead of it.
Bloaters. Pop them away from the trucks.
That's the whole nest coming. Stay on the trucks.
Families are over the line. Come home, Frame.

missions.name: Long Fall
missions.brief: No dropship can get near Thornfield — the air's thick with spore and anti-air. We're dropping you from orbit. Steer your fall, land on something that matters, and burn the great hives.

comms.text: You're falling. Steer with your move stick — land near a hive and the impact does half the work.
Down! Hives are marked. They bud swarm while they stand.
Ground's moving — burrowers. Keep your feet light.
Spore count's falling. I can get in now. North pad.

missions.name: Brood Queen
missions.brief: Something huge is laying eggs under the Crown. The swarm keeps coming back to it. Find it and put it down.

comms.text: You're over the Crown. Ground sensors are jumping — something heavy under the plaza. Stay mobile.
There she is. That's the mother of the lot. Those glowing sacs on her flanks are where the swarmers come from — burst them.
One sac down. The brood's thinning on that side.
Claw's off. She's dragging that side now.
Took her other claw. She'll have to spit at you instead.
Both sacs gone — her head plate's loose. Hit the glowing spot on her head.
She's angry. Watch for a red lane on the ground — that's her charging line. Get off it.
Seeing acid going up from her back. Circles on the ground, frame — don't stand in them.
She's down. Nothing's spawning. Take a breath, then grab what you can.
Pad's lit. Bring that chitin home — the workshop's going to want it.

missions.name: The Long Night
missions.brief: Halden-Voss and the swarm are both pushing into the Spindle tonight. Hold the relay yard, break their siege guns, then burn what the swarm is growing under the plaza. It's a long shift — the dropship marks a checkpoint after each part.

comms.text: Long one tonight, Frame. Three jobs, one district. Every time you finish one, the dropship logs a checkpoint — if it goes bad, we fly you back in from there.
Both sides are in the yard now. Let them chew on each other if you can.
Checkpoint logged. Their siege guns are in the office towers — three of them. Bring the towers down.
Checkpoint logged. Guns are quiet. Now the plaza: the swarm's grown nests under it. Burn all three.
Back in at the siege guns. Same towers, same job.
Back in at the plaza. Three nests. Burn them.
That's the night done. Pad's lit — come home.

missions.name: Crossfire
missions.brief: Red against blue across a downtown block. The last team standing takes the round; first to three rounds wins. Revive your teammates — the other side can't.

missions.name: Scrapyard Brawl
missions.brief: Every frame for itself in a rail yard full of cover. Last one standing takes the round; first to three rounds wins.

missions.name: Iron Stride
missions.brief: Halden-Voss is walking something heavy through the freight yards, flattening whatever it leans on. Hold the yards until it shows, then take it apart.

comms.text: You're over the freight yards. Halden-Voss troopers on every crossing, and the ground's shaking. Clear what you can.
Something big just crushed a warehouse on the far side. It's walking.
That's their siege walker. They call it the Juggernaut. See the glow on its back? That's a shield generator. Get behind it and break it, or you're scratching paint.
Shield's down! The hull's open, so everything you hit counts now.
Main gun's gone. No more red lanes from the front.
One missile rack down. Fewer circles from now on.
Two legs gone and it's on its knees. It can't stomp like that. Pour it on.
It's calling its escort. Watch the red ring under it: when that fills, it stomps. Get clear.
It's dropping mines across the street. Blinking lights on the ground, go round them.
The Juggernaut is down. Halden-Voss just lost its biggest toy. Grab the plating.
Pad's lit. Bring that siege plate home, the workshop will want it.

missions.name: Sawtooth
missions.brief: Halden-Voss has sent one of its named pilots into Foundry Flats to hunt freelancers. Draw her out and beat her.

comms.text: Foundry Flats. Halden-Voss troopers on the ground — and they've brought someone special.
That's their ace. She fights like you do: boosts, dodges, runs hot. Make her burn her energy, then punish her.
She's out. Halden-Voss will remember that name — yours.
Dropship inbound. North-east lot.

missions.name: Quiet Dust
missions.brief: The swarm rode the ore freighters all the way up. Corvane Deep, the mining outpost on the moon, has forty miners sealed in its domes and one cargo lander coming for them. Hold the landing pad while it loads, then go down into the mine and burn the nests before they bud a second wave.

objectives.label: Hold the landing pad while the lander loads
Burn the nests in the mine (4)
Keep the two big domes standing

comms.text: Hold on to something, Frame. The dropship's taking you all the way up this time. Corvane Deep, on the moon.
Gravity's a fraction of home. Your jumps go high and you'll float. Mind where you come down.
The cargo lander needs two and a half minutes on that pad to load the miners. Stand on it and keep it clear.
Acid spitters. Their shots hang up here forever. Watch the circles and step out.
Last miner's aboard. Now the mine. The nests are down in the pit. Burn every one.
Burrowers. The dust is soft up here and they move fast under it.
That's everything still in the tunnels coming up at once. Finish the nests.
Pad's lit on the far side. Climb aboard, and don't jump past the ramp.

missions.name: Proving Ground
missions.brief: Halden-Voss runs its pilots through a rail yard in the Foundry. Tonight it's running you through it: five rounds against their line frames, then their aces. A checkpoint after every round.

comms.text: It's a test, Frame, but their rounds are live. Five rounds. Every one you win, we log a checkpoint.
They're sending an ace. Lancet likes long range — close the gap or keep cover.
Last round. Two aces at once. Split them up.
You cleaned out their whole roster. Pad's lit.

missions.name: Pinewatch
missions.brief: The swarm has spilled out of the city and up into the Pinewatch woods. Coldbrook logging camp is still loading its last trucks. Hold the camp yard until they're out, then hunt down the three nests dug in among the pines and burn them. The Hollin dam upriver keeps the valley's lights on, so try to leave it standing.

objectives.label: Hold the camp yard while the trucks load
Burn the nests in the woods (3)

comms.text: Daylight for once, Frame. That's the Pinewatch ridge under you: pine woods, a river and Coldbrook logging camp.
Smells better than Glasswell from up here. Mind the trees, they stop shots like walls do. Knock them flat if you want a clear line.
The crews are loading their trucks in the yard. Keep the swarm out of it for a minute and a half.
They're coming down the logging road and the trails. Fight in the open, don't let them pin you against the woods.
That concrete wall across the river is the Hollin dam. Half the valley's power. Try not to put it in the water.
Trucks are rolling. Now the nests: three of them dug in among the pines. Follow the arrows and burn them.
Brute on the road. Its front is armoured. Get round behind it.
I'm setting down in the clearing past the river. Wade across, it's only knee deep for a frame.

missions.name: Frostline
missions.brief: North of the city, up where the plough road gives out, Kessrin Station listens to the whole sky. The swarm came down the mountain in the night, and Halden-Voss wants the station's ears for itself. Hold the radar yard while it sends its last sweep home, burn the nests the swarm has dug under the lake ice, and pull the data core out of the frozen relay dish before anyone else does.

objectives.label: Hold the radar yard while it sends
Burn the nests under the lake ice (3)
Bring the data core from the relay dish to the dropship

comms.text: Change of scenery, Frame. No towers, no neon. Kessrin Station, up in the snow north of the city.
Cold one. Fresh snow, and the lake's frozen solid. The ice will hold a frame, but you'll slide on it like a puck.
The radar yard is in the middle of the station. Stand in it while the dome sends its sweep. Two minutes.
Spore drifters riding the wind off the peaks. Don't stand in their clouds.
Sweep's home, and it shows Halden-Voss coming up the plough road. The swarm has nests under the lake ice too. Burn them.
Sniper up on the ridges. Keep moving and put the pines between you.
Lake's clear. Now the relay dish past the lake. The core is frozen in at its foot. Carrying it slows you down.
Everything left on the mountain is coming down at once. Get that core home.
Pad's lit at the end of the east road. Bring the core, and mind the ice on the way.

missions.name: Red Mesa
missions.brief: Halden-Voss is staging its next push from a forward base out in the Redwash badlands, past the end of the city's last road. Topple their radar mast so the gunships fly blind, burn the fuel depot, and catch the supply trucks on the old highway if you can.

comms.text: Look at that. Blue sky, red rock, not a neon sign for a hundred kilometres. Enjoy the view, Frame. Halden-Voss is out here too.
Bright out. The mesas are your friends: nothing they have shoots through rock.
Their radar is on a lattice mast inside the fence. Drop it and their gunships fly blind.
Supply trucks on the old highway, running for the far side. Catch them before they're through.
Shells coming in. They've got a gun truck out past the rocks. Keep moving.
Two line frames out of the hangars. Strikers. Quick ones, so don't let them flank you round a butte.
Mast's down. Now the fuel bladders by the fence. Don't stand next to them when they go.
That's a fire they'll see from the city. Good work.
Pad's lit by the wind farm. Nice change of scenery, wasn't it?
